summary: Run compressed NVFP4 expert scales with TP6 shard geometry and bounded cooperative residency
compatibility: Requires the matching vLLM CSF loader for padded TP6 experts. Inline replacement words remain opt-in; windowed stage reads are the default.
details: K32 down-projection tiles support 352-channel shards, while 64-row slabs retain whole compressed-scale storage units.
The fused kernel accounts for all of its shared-memory regions when choosing cooperative residency.
